DB01/OPS01: existing populated Threads cannot be adopted; Thread creation/grant and accepted message/wake/outbox/ingress fact share outer atomic transactions; immutable release history and fault rollback verified
OPS01/REC01: two actual IPC writers share one SQLite CAS winner; idempotent close receipt survives committed worker SIGKILL; conflicting request and skipped versions rejected

OPS01/ISO03: trusted account ID/config/credential/identity versions and role definition fingerprints freeze in grant; credential rotation blocks stale drain authority without deleting accepted work or accessing secrets

OPS01/REC03/B02: real queue/resource/budget reservation followed by authoritative unknown retains execution uncertainty, usage charge and capacity claim through factory/SQLite recovery; drain never declares ready or replays the backend

OPS01/DB03: consistent SQLite backup restores frozen drain facts under closed mode; pending durable work prevents ready; integrity and foreign keys pass; actual ba438b1 v33 compatibility worker and future writer guard reject without downgrading or deleting data
